description: List sends held for human approval (an external recipient on a sandbox token, or mode="draft"). Scoped to the token's customer and inbox set. Read-only; requires the `read` capability. A human releases a draft out-of-band — the agent cannot send it.

inbox_id.description: Optional inbox filter; omit for all in-scope drafts.
